Grab Just Gained 23% in a Week: Take Profits, or Buy More?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysGrab stock is up 23% in the past week after third-quarter adjusted EBITDA rose 73% to a record $237 million and the company raised its 2026 outlook. The jump came off a three-year low, and Grab still has $500 million left on its buyback.
